title: witheringia procumbens
intro: Witheringia procumbens, commonly known as "Tongkat Ali" or "Longjack", is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia and Malaysia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving stress and anxiety, as well as improving cardiovascular health and immune function. The therapeutic actions of Witheringia procumbens are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include compounds like flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. These constituents are believed to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, contributing to the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
